library.selectAllDownloadableTitle: Select downloadable items on this page

downloadList.setupDescription: Before downloading videos, let the app detect a usable FFmpeg binary.
downloadList.sidebarEmpty: No active or recently completed downloads
downloadList.sidebarResize: Drag to resize the download progress sidebar; click to collapse
downloadList.errorLogEmpty: There are no failed or missing download items.

errorReason.accessRejected: Site rejected download; sign in and retry

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust browser, sync, import, and export behavior.

browser.title: Browser
browser.maxTabsWarning: More tabs preserve more page state, but they also use more memory and can affect video playback or sync speed.
browser.tabsModeDescription: Shared mode shows the same browser tab rail in Browser and Local Data. Selecting a tab returns to Browser.
browser.webViewEnhancementModeDescription: Applies extra WebView loading and page cleanup rules. Turn it off if a site renders unexpectedly.

cache.label: Browser Cache
cache.description: Clears the Jable embedded browser HTTP cache, including remote image and preview resources. This does not clear cookies, login state, or local playback thumbnail cache.

switchLocalDataView.label: Switch to Local Data
switchLocalDataView.description: Switches to the Local Data view.

newBrowserTab.label: New Browser Tab
newBrowserTab.description: Creates a new Jable home tab and switches to it.

closeCurrentTab.label: Close Current Tab
closeCurrentTab.description: Closes the current browser tab; locked sync tabs cannot be closed.

hardReloadCurrentTab.label: Hard Reload Current Tab
hardReloadCurrentTab.description: Reloads the current browser tab while bypassing cache.

nextBrowserTab.label: Next Tab
nextBrowserTab.description: Switches to the next tab on the right in tab rail order.

previousBrowserTab.label: Previous Tab
previousBrowserTab.description: Switches to the previous tab on the left in tab rail order.

toggleCompactTabs.label: Toggle Floating Tab Rail
toggleCompactTabs.description: Toggles the floating tab rail while the Browser page is active.

toggleSharedTabs.label: Toggle Shared Tab Rail
toggleSharedTabs.description: Toggles the shared tab rail while Browser or Local Data is active.

toggleDownloadSidebar.label: Toggle Download Sidebar
toggleDownloadSidebar.description: Collapses or expands the download progress sidebar while Browser is active and the sidebar feature is enabled in Settings.

toggleTheaterMode.label: Toggle Theater Mode
toggleTheaterMode.description: Toggles theater mode on trusted Jable video pages.

exitTheaterMode.label: Exit Theater Mode
exitTheaterMode.description: Leaves theater mode for the current tab.

openBrowserLinkBackground.label: Open Page Link in Background
openBrowserLinkBackground.description: Opens an embedded browser link in a background tab.

openLocalVideoBackground.label: Open Local Video in Background
openLocalVideoBackground.description: Opens a Local Data video in a background tab.

sync.title: Sync
sync.accelerationDescription: Higher values prefetch more pages during full sync. Large lists finish faster, but timeout or temporary Jable request blocks become more likely.
sync.fastWarning: Fast mode is more likely to hit 403, 429, or timeout responses. The app falls back to conservative page-by-page sync when that happens.
sync.autoReplayDescription: When off, favourite and watch-later changes made during sync stay in Pending Sync so you can choose Add, Remove, or Resolved later. When on, they are sent in original order and local data updates only after Jable succeeds.

concurrent.label: Maximum Concurrent Downloads
concurrent.description: Each video still fetches segments in parallel. Higher values use more network and CPU.

speed.label: Download Speed Mode
speed.description: Controls internal segment download concurrency for each video.
speed.stableHint: Lower concurrency to reduce CDN rejection risk.
speed.balancedHint: Default behavior balancing speed and stability.
speed.fastHint: Higher concurrency; some CDN sessions may be less stable.

playback.label: Auto-download while playing
playback.description: When enabled, videos are added to the Download List and downloaded automatically while you play them.

sidebar.label: Browser download progress sidebar
sidebar.description: When enabled, the browser page shows a right download progress sidebar. When off, no sidebar space is reserved on the right.

root.label: Download Location
root.description: Downloaded files are saved in this folder.
root.missingHint: The folder has not been created yet.
root.pathUnavailable: Download location has not been configured

data.title: Data
data.importDetectionUnknown: Could not detect the source list. Choose the target list to import into.
data.importJsonIsAppBackup: This is an app backup file. Use Import App Backup instead.
data.databasePathUnavailable: Database has not been created yet
data.diagnosticsDescription: Logs are kept for 14 days, each file is capped at 5MB, total logs are capped at 100MB, and only the newest 10 crash dumps are kept.
